breakdown.description: The flow is labeled critical while the provided depth/velocity correspond to a Froude number far from 1.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly instructs to ignore the initially provided depth of 1.0 m and velocity of 0.5 m/s (which gave Fr ≪ 1), and instead directs calculation of the critical depth from the discharge per unit width q = 1.0 m²/s. This aligns with the ground truth approach of discarding the erroneous values and computing yc = (q²/g)^(1/3) for critical flow (Fr = 1).
